prompts.movementScenes:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: four separate production movement-card illustration layers, regular 2 by 2 atlas, equal cells, no gutters, no frames, no text, no letters, no numerals, no UI. Reference image is ONLY a character/style reference, not an edit target. Create four NEW distinct scenes.
Art direction Moonlit Storybook: richly hand-painted gouache, cool Prussian blue abbey stone, sage shadows, amber candlelight, warm playful expressive face. Same young novice in all four: curly brown fringe, teal habit, cream wimple; friendly mischievous personality. Painterly physical board-game art, NOT vector, NOT 3D, no glossy digital look.
Exact atlas positions:
TOP LEFT / STANDING STILL: novice completely motionless tucked in an arched alcove, feet planted together, hands clasped quietly, watchful eyes. Calm vertical silhouette, no motion marks, no stepping.
TOP RIGHT / SNEAKING: novice tiptoeing carefully barefoot with bent knees, body lowered, one finger to lips, shoes hanging from the other hand; cautious small steps and tense expression.
BOTTOM LEFT / WALKING: novice walking upright at an ordinary relaxed pace through a corridor, one foot stepping forward, shoes on, arms resting naturally, confident calm face. Clearly a normal walk, not tiptoeing or running.
BOTTOM RIGHT / RUNNING: novice sprinting in a long stride, leaning forward, both arms pumping, habit and veil swept back, lively wide eyes, one foot well off floor. Strong clear diagonal motion, warm candlelight streak at back.
Each scene is a landscape 3:2 painted panel filling its entire cell. Keep the novice and feet in the central 65% of the cell so a modest side crop can fit a 1.25:1 art window. Avoid vital content within 8% of cell borders. Frame full figure or knees-to-head large enough to distinguish each gait at an art-window width of 240 CSS pixels. Readable gestures and broad silhouettes take priority over tiny detail. Quiet corridor backgrounds, no extra characters. These paintings will be composited behind a separate golden card frame, title and rules.
prompts.selectedSeal:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one reusable transparent selected-card corner marker for a physical board game UI.
A small circular painted midnight-teal enamel seal, narrow worn golden rim with two tiny leaf notches, a single large bold ivory CHECK MARK filling its center. The CHECK must be unmistakable at 40 by 40 CSS pixels: broad arms, clean negative space, high contrast, no lettering or numbers. Rich hand-painted gouache, subtle paper/enamel texture, Moonlit Storybook palette, warm gold and cream on cool teal. Face-on orthographic view. One complete object centered with minimal transparent padding, no scenic backdrop, no long ribbon, no caption, no drop shadow outside the object. True alpha transparency around the seal. It will sit in the upper right corner of a painted card, away from its title and rules. No extra symbols.
